liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Scarlet Begonias** (4 reviews): Reviewer calls the Scarlet into Fire a hidden gem, and says the rest of the set is also worth hearing; Scarlet into Fire segue judged the best the reviewer has heard; band tight, Donna strong, Jerry sounding playful [7][11][12][15]
- **Estimated Prophet** (2 reviews): Reviewer praises the Estimated Prophet and Eyes of the World pairing; Estimated Prophet is nice, with Jerry's playing rising and falling; Eyes of the World is fast [13][15]
- **Wharf Rat** (2 reviews): Reviewer singles out Jerry's blistering solos in Wharf Rat [16][17]
- **Looks Like Rain** (2 other sources): The set-one soundboard places Looks Like Rain between Brown Eyed Women and China Cat; this audience source lacks it; This listing puts Looks Like Rain after Brown Eyed Women and before China Cat Sunflower [1][2]
- **Promised Land** (1 other source): Sound and PA problems affect Promised Land on this recording [1]
- **Fire On The Mountain** (1 review): Fire has a fast groove, with Jerry playing lightning quick and singing with passion [15]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Reviewer picks The Other One as excellent, coming out of the Drums and space [13]

## The recordings

- **gd1979-02-03.154522.aud.clugston.flac16** (recommended): audience recording; 21 songs; 162 min; rated 5/5 by 3 [1]
- **gd1979-02-03.set1.sbd.miller.102851.flac16**: soundboard; 12 songs; 76 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1979-02-03.set1.sbd.miller.102445.flac16**: soundboard; 12 songs; 75 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd79-02-03.set2-nak.clugston.7116.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 11 songs; 96 min; rated 4.77/5 by 30 [5]. Said about its sound: The audience's enthusiasm can be heard clearly on the recording [11]
- **gd79-02-03.aud.set1.warner.19414.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 10 songs; 58 min; rated 3.11/5 by 19 [6]. Said about its sound: Audience recording of set one is poor: first track and a half terrible, improving somewhat by track three; Reviewer says the first-set audience recording sounds worse than the second-set one [10][17]

## Around the show

- Reviewer notes the show falls in Keith's last days with the band, a period often overlooked [7]
- Reviewer ranks this Scarlet into Fire among the best ever played [9]
- Reviewer has long considered this a highly underrated show, with ripping guitar solos throughout [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1979-02-03.154522.aud.clugston.flac16**: taped by Unknown; transferred by Scot Clugston; source: Master Audience Cassettes; Unknown Equipment > 1st generation cassettes > .wav 1644 [1]. Also: Sourced from anonymous first-generation cassettes; includes set one, missing from shnid7116, and upgrades the multi-generation audience source 19414 [1]
- **gd1979-02-03.set1.sbd.miller.102851.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony D5) -> Cassette (Sony D5) [2]. Also: Set-one soundboard upgrade of shnid 102445 with patches added; tapes came from David Young and Rich Rothenberg; Pitch correction was done with help from Joe B. Jones [2]
- **gd1979-02-03.set1.sbd.miller.102445.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony D5) -> Cassette (Sony D5) [3]. Also: Set-one soundboard from tapes supplied by David Young and Rich Rothenberg, pitch corrected with help from Joe B. Jones [3]
- **gd79-02-03.set2-nak.clugston.7116.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording: Nakamichi CM700 mics [5]. Also: Second-set Nak audience source, CD mastered and converted to SHN by Scott Clugston using EAC [5]
- **gd79-02-03.aud.set1.warner.19414.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Scott Zarnegar and Jack Warner; source: Audience Recording [6]

## Art and photos

- Poster by David Franklin_Perkins Grateful Dead: [1979-02-03 Market Square Arena, Indianapolis, IN, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1979-02-03-market-square-arena-indianapolis-in-usa/) [24]
